findings.evidence: In the once-opened whole-mobile preview, a second title/breadcrumb and introductory vapor/pressure text appear in the lower region following part of example2, rather than the expected final volume-change explanation.

supportingExistingTextEvidence.expectedLastLessonBlock: The negative sign means the volume decreases by0.3 m3. This conclusion assumes constant temperature, no loss of total mass, and the stated ideal-gas approximation for the vapor.

findings.impact: The supplied mobile whole-course visual evidence cannot demonstrate the actual course ending. A passed DOM/width contract alone does not cure that saved-pixel evidence gap.
findings.diagnosisLimit: The observed anomaly is in the delivered saved-image preview. Capture corruption versus tool preview transport/rendering is not determined. No repeated source text, duplicate DOM heading or product-content defect is asserted solely from this tiny preview.
findings.localAction: Keep the current source, Chinese, figure, science, draft and native/width PASS evidence. In a separately authorized fresh context, investigate or replace only the affected mobile whole-course saved-capture/preview evidence so its lower end reliably shows the expected final example conclusion without restarting the introduction. Do not edit content or replay unrelated approvals in response to this finding.
findings.acceptance: Bounded affected visual evidence unambiguously reaches the closing deltaV/sign/model-condition paragraphs, with no restarted title/introductory block. Bind any replacement to its actual bytes and the unchanged native/displayed-lesson provenance.
